summary: An excerpt from a novel (labeled 'Book 3 — part 8') in which Carly Grove, a single woman who cannot conduct a pregnancy, describes her failed attempts at adoption and her contact with Children of Light, an adoption organization linked to a clinic up the Hudson run by Dr. Alex Goddard. The narrator's scene is a mini film shoot where Carly is being interviewed on camera, and the narrator presses for details about her dealings with the organization. The passage is largely dialogue, with the interviewer hungry for specifics as Carly pushes on, dismissive of Goddard's pitch.
one_line: In a novel excerpt, single woman Carly Grove recounts failed adoption attempts and her dealings with the Children of Light clinic and Dr. Alex Goddard during a filmed interview.
key_facts: Carly Grove says she was told that an in vitro procedure was not an option and that, to have a baby, she had to adopt.
Carly Grove started on the attorney route and was worked over trying to adopt as a single mom before hearing about Children of Light.
Carly Grove describes Children of Light as the place that can make it happen, meaning adoption.
A filmed interview is being shot in a living room turned into a mini film set with two 35-mm Panaflex cameras, a video camera and monitor.
The clapstick marks the start as 'Scene one, take one, Carly Grove interview.'
Carly Grove says she tried to adopt the baby of a woman in a Memphis jail, and that adoption fell through.
Carly Grove's main lawyer, Chuck, recommended she hock the family silver, take a Valium, and try Children of Light.
Children of Light first tried to get Carly to check into their clinic up the Hudson to see if her 'condition' could be cured using Goddard's special techniques.
Dr. Alex Goddard is described by Carly as a kinda spacey guy and the big-shot presiding guru at the clinic.
Carly told Goddard's staff she did not have that kind of time and that nothing could be done.
Carly eventually spoke with Dr. Alex Goddard himself, who mesmerized her, but she said it was adoption or nothing.
Goddard sent Carly back to the staff, and she summed up the outcome as 'Checkbook time.'
The narrator is Tony's companion on set, and Sherry and Tony are ready with the boom mike and tape recorder.
Kevin, a baby, is handed to Marcy before the interview begins.
